# Tag

## Summary
Base-realm label card for tagging and grouping other cards. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/tag` (default export `Tag`, a CardDef).

## API
- `name` — the label text
- `color`, `fontColor`, `borderColor` — ColorFields for pill styling
- `ellipsize` — BooleanField, truncate long names in tight layouts

## Usage
```ts
import Tag from 'https://cardstack.com/base/tag';

@field tags = linksToMany(Tag);
```
Atom format renders the classic tag pill; instances are shared across cards
so renaming a tag updates everywhere it is linked.
